scenes.text: Your loss limit moves up. It never moves back down.
scenes.say: On a prop account, your loss limit moves up with you. It never moves back down.

scenes.title: 50K account, $2,000 end-of-day trailing
head: Day
Close
Loss limit
scenes.say: Close at fifty thousand eight hundred, and the limit climbs to forty eight thousand eight hundred. Lose five hundred the next day, and it stays there.
On many accounts it stops trailing at the starting balance plus one hundred dollars. From there, it's locked.

scenes.title: Balance vs loss limit, day by day.
scenes.say: Prop Firm Manager replays every day with your firm's rules, so you always see the real number.
